Indicator 01

6H Sessions AIO Package

A comprehensive All-In-One Pine Script indicator built around fixed 6-hour session candles. Combines HTF structure, SMT divergence, FVGs, and 15m CHoCH into one unified narrative.

Concept

Basic Theory of Indicator 01

Asia has a story to tell — one that hardly anyone bothers to listen to.

London Protraction — London extends the direction Asia already showed.
New York Reversal — NY sweeps both sessions' liquidity, then reverses on CISD.
New York Continuation — NY takes London's liquidity, then runs with Asia's direction.
London Continuation — London builds on Asia without ever touching its liquidity.

When Asia consolidates

The read shifts to London — it will almost always come back to liquidate Asia's range. That sets up a high chance of a London Protraction or a New York Reversal forming the same day. Spot the PD array left inside London, wait for price to break out in that direction, then look for a lower-timeframe liquidity sweep and CISD before taking the entry.

When Asia trends

It has a story to tell too — it usually sets the high or low of the day. London will revisit the Asian FVGs and respect them. If London consolidates instead, New York liquidates London, revisits the same Asian FVGs, respects them, and propagates in the direction Asia originally showed.

Core Engine & Confluence

Every component is designed to filter noise and highlight high-probability institutional footprints.

🕒

Fixed 6H Sessions

Locked quarterly blocks (Asia, London, NY AM, NY PM) providing a clean HTF session narrative view on your LTF charts.

📊

Smart Money Technique

Live 6H, 4H, and 1H SMT divergence detection against correlated pairs to confirm genuine smart-money movement.

🎯

Multi-TF FVG Layers

Tracks Daily, 4H, 1H, and Session FVGs. Automatically marks First Inversions (IFVG) and double-inversion removals.

⚡

15m CHoCH Trigger

Rules-based entry model. The system "arms" on HTF events and waits for a precise 15m Change of Character to execute.

Classic Session Narratives

The indicator automatically maps and supports the four primary ICT session trading models.

London Protraction

00:00 – 06:00 NY

London continues or expands the direction established in Asia. Highlights Asia FVGs attacked during the London open.

New York Reversal

06:00 – 12:00 NY

NY AM reverses the London direction. Uses 6H SMT divergence and session FVG attacks to arm the reversal.

New York Continuation

06:00 – 12:00 NY

NY expands the London direction. Confirmed by same-direction 6H SMT and respected unmitigated session FVGs.

London Continuation

00:00 – 06:00 NY

Focuses on the early expansion of London continuing Asia. Tracks IFVG formations and 6H SMT confirmations.

Indicator 02

FVG Sweep & HTF Reversal Alerts

A companion indicator built around the IRL → ERL approach — trading from Fair Value Gaps out to External Range Liquidity, every session.

Core

Multi-Timeframe FVG Alerts

Fires the moment price attacks a 1H, 4H, Daily or Weekly FVG on the most recent orderflow leg — the IRL you're actually meant to be trading from, not just any gap on the chart.

Core

Live ERL Levels

Plots the External Range Liquidity tied to that same leg, so the day's draw — where price is being pulled toward — is always marked on the chart.

Bonus

Candle 2 Closure Alerts

Flags the close of the second candle on the Daily, Weekly and Monthly open — one of the earliest and cleanest tells for a higher-timeframe reversal forming in real time.

Framework

IRL → ERL Trading

Built around trading from internal liquidity (the FVG) out to external liquidity — the same day-to-day framework used to trade every session live.

Indicator 03

MSNR Key Levels

Automatic H4, Daily, Weekly and Monthly swing levels, with alerts built for a two-stage entry: the level retest, then the lower-timeframe confirmation.

Classic V Level

The Valley

A swing low left behind on the H4, Daily, Weekly or Monthly chart — marked ".V" on the level. It holds as a demand zone until price closes back through it, and stays live on the chart until it's either retested or invalidated.

Classic A Level

The Apex

A swing high left behind on the same timeframes — marked ".A". It holds as a supply zone the same way a Classic V does, and gets removed the moment price closes cleanly through it.

H4 / D / W / M Coverage

Plots Classic V and Classic A levels across four timeframes at once, each tagged by origin (H4, D, W, M) so you always know which structure a level came from.

Auto-Invalidation

A level is removed the moment price closes beyond it (or wicks through it, your choice) — so the chart only ever shows levels that are still actually in play.

Retest Alerts

Fires the instant price comes back to tag a live MSNR level for the first time — naming the exact timeframe and level, e.g. "H4.A" or "W.V".

LTF CHOCH Confirmation

After the retest, it watches the 1H / 30M structure for a Change of Character. Only once that CHOCH prints does the entry alert fire — the retest alone is never enough.

NZD/JPY, Daily — H4.A, W.A and D.A levels marked, with a CHOCH tag after the retest.
NZD/CAD, Daily — two Daily Apex levels stacking above price, plus a CHOCH after the H4 retest.
NAS100, Daily — Weekly and H4 Valley levels holding as support through the August pullback.
Indicator 04

CRT Pro with RB & SMT

Candle Range Theory across multiple timeframes, with SMT divergence calculated for you automatically. No manual pair-checking, no second chart.

C1

The Range

One candle sets the range. Its high becomes the CRT High, its low the CRT Low, and the halfway point is the 50% midpoint. This is the box the next candles are judged against.

C2

The Manipulation

The next candle pushes beyond one side of the range and takes the liquidity resting there, then rejects. Those who chased the break are trapped on the wrong side. That rejection is the setup.

C3

The Expansion

With the sweep done, price tends to travel across the range toward the opposite side of C1. The midpoint is a natural first checkpoint, and the far side of the range is the full target.

Why it works

Every range has liquidity sitting just outside its edges: stops from traders on the wrong side, and breakout orders from those chasing. C2 exists to collect it. Once that liquidity is taken, there is little reason left for price to keep going, and it often rotates back through the range. CRT gives that idea a fixed, repeatable shape you can read on any timeframe.

The Rejection Block version

This indicator detects CRTs using rejection-block rules rather than eyeballing. C1 must be a meaningful candle (sized against ATR, so tiny mother candles are ignored). C2 must sweep beyond C1 with a real rejection wick, sized against both its own body and ATR. A close back inside the range is not forced, so you catch the sweeps that matter without waiting on a strict rule that arrives too late. Every threshold is adjustable.

SMT Divergence

Confirmation that calculates itself

SMT compares two closely correlated markets. When one makes a new high or low and its partner fails to follow, the move lacks broad participation, which often marks a sweep that is about to fail. That is exactly what you want to see alongside a C2.

CRT Pro picks the correlated pair for the chart you are on, pulls its data, and marks the divergence automatically, using both adjacent-wick and pivot-based detection. When a CRT and an SMT agree, you get a confluence alert. There is nothing to configure per symbol.

EURUSD ↔ GBPUSD EURJPY ↔ GBPJPY NZDUSD ↔ AUDUSD NZDJPY ↔ AUDJPY NAS100 ↔ SPX500 XAUUSD ↔ XAGUSD BTCUSD ↔ ETHUSD USDJPY ↔ CADJPY USDCAD ↔ SGDCAD EURCHF ↔ GBPCHF

Trading something else? Set any manual pair in the settings.

Multi-Timeframe CRT

Track up to four CRT timeframes at once (H1 and H4 on by default), each with its own colors, so a higher-timeframe range and a lower-timeframe sweep sit on the same chart.

Automatic SMT

Auto pair selection, adjacent-wick and three-length pivot divergence, and lines that clear themselves when the partner market breaks the reference.

Turtle Soup Signals

Buy and sell markers when price sweeps a CRT extreme and closes back inside, confirmed on bar close so signals don't repaint mid-candle.

Alerts & Dashboard

Alerts for CRT + SMT confluence, Turtle Soup buys and sells per timeframe, and active SMT. A compact dashboard shows every timeframe's status, range and SMT state at a glance.
